ok, the idea is to put 0s on “new” and “attachmentsNew” inside the dialogues key.

“dialogues”: { “59e7125688a45068a6249071”: { “_id”: “59e7125688a45068a6249071”, “type”: 7, “messages”: [ ….. ], “pinned”: false, “new”: 61, “attachmentsNew”: 64 …. ….Updated:
